infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: DayLog reads your Health data to sync steps and sleep insights.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: DayLog may write wellness summaries to Health when enabled.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: DayLog uses your location while you use the app to derive coarse daily movement context.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: DayLog can optionally collect coarse background movement context when you explicitly enable background tracking.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: DayLog uses your location while the app is open to generate coarse context signals.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: DayLog can optionally use coarse background location to improve context summaries when you explicitly enable it.
